author: SlyNine
quote:
This is terrible. These characters are the worst, you can tell the development team has changed to a certain demographic. I bet they only left strippers in in hopes to claim it's not woke trash. This is woke trash. While you can skip some of it, it still sticks it in your face often.

Jason has no personality, sticks by a women who betrayed his trust and didn't tell him he had a child. This should be a revenge story, not doing chores for this terrible woman.

I would give it a two, but the people giving it 10's is too much. So zero is what it gets.

author: SlyNine
quote: Love it, lots of fun. It's a vehicle simulator sandbox first and a game second. As long as you know that going in you'll have a great time. If you expect a deep story, or any story, this isn't for you. It's about playing with cars in a realistic simulation.
